### Human Leather + An Slua + Displaced

![Human Leather](space/human-leather.jpg)

Brighton's *Human Leather*, recently signed to Wrong Speed Records, come to Ireland for the first time. The two piece, reminiscent of early Adebisi Shank and Melvins, are hugely popular on the UK DIY scene. Check out their new video here. https://youtu.be/UR61qWeckwM?si=9vO6zmm74p3z7niz

*An Slua* are probably the best punk band to come from Ireland in the last 10 years. Festival appearances in France and beyond have cemented this. FFO Section 4 and Runnin Riot. Debut album coming soon.

Bringing some alt rock sounds to the mix are local young upstarts *Displaced* .

### Event Details
- **Date:** Saturday 6th September 2025
- **Time:** 9pm
- **Location:** TheNCF Cultural Coop, 5 Pearse Street, F26 C925
- **Admission:** €10 on the door (first come first served)
